mutants.models: parameter enumeration that misses one binding of an enabled action
mutants.name: drops_a_binding

mutants.models: an out-edge missing from the liveness table, so a cycle cannot be found
mutants.name: drops_a_liveness_edge

mutants.models: a parallel merge that loses one worker's states, under-counting the search
mutants.name: drops_a_worker_contribution

mutants.models: successor generation that silently omits an action
mutants.name: drops_an_action

mutants.models: an action taken in a state its guard forbids. Measured as a TIMEOUT and not as a gap: without guards the search is bounded only by the variables' declared types, which on raft_election is astronomically large, so no gate that has to finish can ever kill it. The axis is real; a terminating gate is the wrong instrument for it, and #50's generated models — small by construction — are the right one
mutants.name: ignores_a_guard

mutants.models: an ENABLED bit recorded the wrong way round, so fairness is read inverted
mutants.name: inverts_a_weak_fairness_bit

mutants.models: a trace one step short, because the walk back drops a step
mutants.name: off_by_one_in_the_path_walk

mutants.models: a coverage merge taking `param_universe` from the worker rather than the coordinator. D-27 names this asymmetry. The CORPUS does not catch it — `finalize/2` drops `param_universe` from the report, so a wrong one shows only where a run has unreached params to name — and #39's unit tests do
mutants.name: param_universe_from_the_right

mutants.models: a frontier that stops being breadth-first, so a counterexample is no longer the shortest — the length D-9 compares and D-27's barrier exists to preserve
mutants.name: searches_depth_first

mutants.models: a symmetric state that is not put in canonical form, so an orbit is explored twice
mutants.name: skips_symmetry_canonicalization

mutants.models: state identity narrow enough to collide, silently merging distinct states
mutants.name: truncates_the_fingerprint

mutants.models: a corpus entry typing a variable more loosely than the TLA+ it is checked against — the defect found by reading the corpus rather than by running it
mutants.name: weakens_a_type_domain

mutants.models: replay starting from the wrong `init` block, which only a spec with more than one can expose
mutants.name: wrong_init_index
